description: Routing accuracy corpus — phrases that should/should not activate report-strategic. Adversarial cases discriminate it from its three near-synonymous siblings (report-brief, report-state, report-progress), the hard routing boundary flagged in the 2026-05-31 review.
trigger_phrases: leadership briefing with findings and recommendations
executive report that grounds readers in shared vocabulary first
strategic analysis for a mixed audience
findings report with context-setting and recommendations
strategic assessment with evidence and takeaways
thought-leadership document that must be self-contained
produce a formal strategic document with recommendations
strategic positioning analysis for the org
write up the strategy with glossary, context, findings, and recommendations
adversarial_phrases: give me a one-page intel brief with confidence levels
BLUF assessment of the vendor in three sentences
what is the current health of our platform right now
weekly project status with blockers, RAG, and next steps
write the PRD for this feature
notes: Adversarials route to siblings: intel-brevity/BLUF/confidence → report-brief; current-state/health-snapshot → report-state; project/sprint status + blockers + RAG → report-progress; PRD → plan-prd. report-strategic owns context-setting + strategic recommendation for a mixed/external audience.
